MEDIA TECHNOLOGY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #4
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: MEDIA TECHNOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   B. Ignore burnt cables
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun

2. When learning Photography: technology and techniques 2.2 Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Pr, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Photography: technology and techniques 2.2 Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Pr.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Photography: technology and techniques 2.2 Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Pr.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Photography: technology and techniques 2.2 Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Pr.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Photography: technology and techniques 2.2 Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Pr.

3. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. CPU
   B. Keyboard
   C. Monitor
   D. Speaker

4. When learning Live streaming Project, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Live streaming Project.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Live streaming Project.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Live streaming Project.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Live streaming Project.

5. When learning Fundamentals of Media Technology, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Fundamentals of Media Technology.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Fundamentals of Media Technology.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Fundamentals of Media Technology.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Fundamentals of Media Technology.

6. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Information and Communication Technology
   B. International Cricket Team
   C. Input Cable Tester
   D. Internal Cooking Timer

7. When learning Photography: technology and techniques, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Photography: technology and techniques.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Photography: technology and techniques.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Photography: technology and techniques.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Photography: technology and techniques.

8. When learning Pre-production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-production 1.5 Project Activity 2.0 Media, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Pre-production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-production 1.5 Project Activity 2.0 Media.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Pre-production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-production 1.5 Project Activity 2.0 Media.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Pre-production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-production 1.5 Project Activity 2.0 Media.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Pre-production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-production 1.5 Project Activity 2.0 Media.

9. When learning Pre- production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Pre- production.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Pre- production.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Pre- production.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Pre- production.

10. When learning Digital Video Production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Digital Video Production.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Digital Video Production.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Digital Video Production.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Digital Video Production.

11. When learning Production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Production.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Production.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Production.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Production.

12. When learning Post-production 1.5 Project Activity 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photography: techn, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Post-production 1.5 Project Activity 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photography: techn.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Post-production 1.5 Project Activity 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photography: techn.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Post-production 1.5 Project Activity 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photography: techn.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Post-production 1.5 Project Activity 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photography: techn.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Media ownership and management Page 12 of 42 1 STRAND 1.0: MEDIA CONTENT CREATIO and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Media ownership and management and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Fundamentals of Emerging Media Technology 1.2 Pre-production 1.3 Production 1.4  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Fundamentals of Media Technology and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
